limitations: Operation counts only. Wall times were neither claimed nor compared; the replay ran locally in the validator's 4-vCPU container (not isolab-eks), which is acceptable because no wall time is admitted.

The matched rho reference prices every walk without the [d]G = Q check (E25's and E31's convention, 0.13-0.78 % of a <±psi> walk) while the index calculus keeps its own check_muls; this favours rho, so the distances are conservative for the index calculus.

The batched walk (iii) runs in e27_walk, the index calculus in quartic_pipeline_gls: two binaries of one build (same commit, same crypto_lib counters). The pipeline process's own walks equal Stage W's walk (ii) record for record, and (iii) differs from (ii) only by the price of the recorded F_p inversions (identity checked on all 20 pools); same_binary_or_process is asserted on that basis.

Batched inversions are charged 3(m-1)+16 per round with m the round's inversions (all independent: begin/end additions; the inverses returned are the ones used, so bit-identity covers them). m averages above 16 because set-up rounds carry many independent scalar-multiplication steps; fillers keep the pool at 16 walks. The 16 charged per F_p inversion is the repository's convention, unchanged.

The index-calculus side is not batched (bound in errata E2); §5a's unpriced native work is priced only as one GAE per Macaulay entry and per walk step, as registered; F_p additions and the walks' hash traffic stay unpriced on both sides.
Scale: p = 101-397 (n of 22.6-33.6 bits), two seeds per p, 16 walks per fold; the 1.45x reference correction is measured on these curves only.

Unit tests ran on the recorded tree plus the producer's later test-only repair of an unrelated test helper (src/ml_dataset/storage.rs, commit ed49f1378), without which the lib test target does not compile at af2504ef1.
